about: Free fonts PressRoom installs for the user (Windows per-user fonts): look-alikes of Microsoft 365 cloud fonts that only Office can draw, ADLaM Display itself, and the free fonts Microsoft 365 offers online (Montserrat, Lobster, Pacifico, ...) in the weights Microsoft lists, so they are in PressRoom under the same names. All under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, Apache 2.0 or the Ubuntu Font Licence, from Google Fonts. build-installer.ps1 downloads them into target-pkg and checks each SHA-256; font files are never committed (CLAUDE.md).
